plain: A chess-style score that goes up when you win and down when you lose, more so after surprising results.
eli5: Beating a strong player earns you lots of points; beating a weak one earns only a few.
technical: Online update of a logistic rating after each game: r ← r + K(S − E), with E the expected score from the rating gap (400 points = 10:1 odds). Order-dependent, so a fixed-strength player's rating still wanders; Bradley–Terry is the batch maximum-likelihood counterpart.
